nodes.label: personality.py
nodes.description: System prompt and proactive alert templates for Jarvis. Defines SYSTEM_PROMPT with style rules (voice output, TTS-friendly, no markdown), behavior guidelines (proactive monitoring, confirmation for destructive actions, coding help), and the proactive_alert function that formats alert messages.

key_elements: SYSTEM_PROMPT constant with voice-first style rules
proactive_alert function for TTS and Telegram alerts

nodes.label: SYSTEM_PROMPT
nodes.description: Multi-line system prompt string defining Jarvis personality. Includes voice-optimized style rules (short sentences, no markdown, TTS-friendly), proactive behavior, confirmation workflow for destructive actions, and tool usage guidelines.

nodes.label: proactive_alert()
nodes.description: Formats proactive alert messages for TTS or Telegram. Takes source, situation description, and optional suggested action. Returns 'Sir, {situation}. Shall I {action}?' or 'Sir, {situation}.' if no action provided.

nodes.label: nodes.py
nodes.description: LangGraph node functions for the Jarvis agent graph. Core orchestration logic including memory retrieval, LLM interaction via claude -p subprocess, tool calling with confirmation workflow, and response handling. Implements the think-act-observe-respond cycle.

key_features: Claude CLI subprocess streaming with sentence callbacks
Tool call confirmation for destructive operations
Tool call parsing from markdown code blocks

nodes.label: retrieve_memory_node()
nodes.description: LangGraph node that retrieves relevant memories from Mem0Store based on the last user message. Returns up to 5 memories or empty list if mem0_store is None. Extracts last user message with string content from state.

nodes.label: _build_system_with_memories()
nodes.description: Private helper that augments SYSTEM_PROMPT with retrieved memories. If memories exist, appends section 'What you know about this user (strong priors, not absolute truth)' with bulleted memory list.

nodes.label: _build_claude_prompt()
nodes.description: Converts message history to single prompt string for claude -p. Wraps system in <system> tags and messages in role tags. Handles list-based content with tool_result and tool_use blocks.

metadata.note: Legacy function, not actively used by _run_claude

nodes.label: _run_claude()
nodes.description: Async function that streams claude -p subprocess. Fires sentence_callback per sentence for TTS. Runs with --permission-mode bypassPermissions, --output-format stream-json, --verbose. OAuth from macOS keychain, no API key needed. Parses stream events for text deltas.

nodes.label: think_node()
nodes.description: Main LLM reasoning node. Builds memory-augmented system prompt with tool descriptions. Runs multi-turn loop (MAX_TURNS=6) calling _run_claude, parsing tool calls from ```tool_call blocks, checking for confirmation requirements. Returns final response or pending action requiring confirmation.

nodes.label: act_node()
nodes.description: Executes tool calls via toolbox.dispatch. Iterates over state tool_calls, dispatches each, collects results. Appends tool_result messages to conversation. Returns updated messages with results.

nodes.label: observe_node()
nodes.description: Clears tool_results from state after they've been processed. Simple node that returns empty tool_results list if any existed.

nodes.label: respond_node()
nodes.description: Extracts final_response from state. If confirmation required, formats pending action message. Otherwise extracts text content from last assistant message, handling both string and list-based content formats.

nodes.label: store_memory_node()
nodes.description: Stores user and assistant messages to Mem0Store for future retrieval. Extracts last user message and final_response, stores each with appropriate role. Returns empty dict (side-effect only node).

nodes.label: CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
nodes.description: Set of tool names requiring user confirmation before execution: write_file, run_shell, create_event, update_event, send_email. Used by think_node to gate destructive operations.

nodes.label: TOOL_CALL_RE
nodes.description: Regex pattern to extract tool calls from LLM output. Matches ```tool_call markdown code blocks with JSON content. Used by think_node to parse tool invocations.

nodes.label: MAX_TURNS
nodes.description: Maximum number of think-act loop iterations. Set to 6 to prevent infinite tool calling loops.

nodes.label: calendar.py
nodes.description: Calendar proactive monitor that polls Google Calendar and surfaces alerts. CalendarMonitor class checks for upcoming events within 30 minutes and invokes the agent graph to generate concise alerts via notify_fn.

nodes.label: CalendarMonitor
nodes.description: Polls Google Calendar every poll_seconds (default 300s). Fetches next day's events, prompts agent graph to identify events requiring action (within 30 minutes), and sends alerts via notify_fn if response is not NO_ACTION.

nodes.label: __init__()
nodes.description: Initializes CalendarMonitor with agent graph, calendar tools toolbox, notify callback, and poll interval in seconds.

nodes.label: check_once()
nodes.description: Single calendar check. Fetches events for next day via calendar_tools.dispatch('list_events', days=1). Creates AgentState with monitoring prompt asking if any events need attention. Invokes graph and sends alert via notify_fn if response != NO_ACTION.

nodes.label: run_forever()
nodes.description: Infinite loop that runs check_once every poll_seconds. Logs start message with poll interval.

nodes.label: email.py
nodes.description: Email proactive monitor that polls Gmail and surfaces urgent items. EmailMonitor class checks for unread emails requiring decisions and invokes agent graph to generate one-sentence alerts with suggested actions.

nodes.label: EmailMonitor
nodes.description: Polls Gmail every poll_seconds (default 600s). Fetches up to 5 unread emails, prompts agent graph to identify urgent items requiring decisions, and sends alerts via notify_fn if response is not NO_ACTION.

nodes.label: __init__()
nodes.description: Initializes EmailMonitor with agent graph, email tools toolbox, notify callback, and poll interval in seconds.

nodes.label: check_once()
nodes.description: Single email check. Fetches unread emails via email_tools.dispatch('list_emails', query='is:unread', limit=5). Creates AgentState with monitoring prompt asking if anything is urgent. Invokes graph and sends alert via notify_fn if response != NO_ACTION.

nodes.label: run_forever()
nodes.description: Infinite loop that runs check_once every poll_seconds. Logs start message with poll interval.

nodes.label: state.py
nodes.description: AgentState TypedDict definition for the LangGraph agent graph. Defines typed state structure with trigger source, message history, memories, tool calls/results, output channel, confirmation workflow fields, and passed-through objects (settings, toolbox, tts_callback).

nodes.label: AgentState
nodes.description: TypedDict (total=False) defining LangGraph state schema. Fields include trigger (voice/calendar/email/watchdog), messages list, memories list, tool_calls/results, output_channel, final_response, confirmation workflow (requires_confirmation, pending_action), error, and pass-through objects (settings, toolbox, tts_callback).
